description: She who fulfills all desires — the creative impulse at the origin of manifestation
weapons_full: sugarcane bow (ikṣu-danda), flowery arrows (pañca-bāṇa), aṅkuśa (goad), pāśa (noose)
ornaments: crown of rubies, throat ornament, necklaces, waist‐chain, gemmed rings on feet and hands, crescent moon on head

description: Garlanded with auspiciousness — she who bestows the six blessings of the Bhaga
weapons_full: aṅkuśa, pāśa, sugarcane bow; 5 flowery arrows

description: Ever-moist with compassion — she dissolves the dryness of separation
ornaments: smeared with red sandalwood paste and beads of sweat on forehead

description: The fierce one — she who destroys obstacles through her terrifying form
weapons_full: aṅkuśa, śūla (spear), vajra (thunderbolt), sword; pāśa, bow, gāda (mace), shield

description: She who dwells in fire — transforming the gross into the subtle through sacred flame
ornaments: rubies, diadem with rubies, anklets, gem waist-chain, pearls

description: Mistress of the great thunderbolt — her power cuts through delusion instantly
Shiva's emissary — she carries messages between the absolute and the manifest
weapons_full: aṅkuśa, sword, axe, pāśa, shield, gada

description: The swift one — she acts before thought can obstruct — pure spontaneous grace
Beautiful within the sacred lineage — she reveals the aesthetic dimension of liberation
ornaments: crown with gems and rubies, necklaces, earrings, armlets (navaratna)

description: The eternal one — she who IS beyond time while dwelling within it completely
ornaments: smeared with red sandalwood paste and beads of sweat on forehead

description: Bearer of the blue banner — she signals the victory of consciousness over matter
The victorious one — she who overcomes all obstacles through the power of dharma
Beautiful in every limb — she is the perfection of form as a pathway to formlessness
Garlanded with flames — she who burns away the residue of karma at the threshold

mantra_short: Om Aim Hrīm Śrīm Klīm Citrāyai
description: The wondrous one — at full moon she reveals the full spectrum of consciousness as beauty
